title: Nonempty mod-three coefficients
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $S$ be a nonempty set of coordinates in the $n$-dimensional sign cube. The Fourier coefficient at $S$ of the indicator that the sum of the input signs is divisible by $3$ equals $\frac{2}{3}(-\frac12)^n(-1)^{(|S|\bmod 4)/2}(\sqrt{3})^{|S|}$ if $|S|$ is even, and equals $0$ if $|S|$ is odd.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a subset of the $n$ coordinates
